title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Lesson 45 ]

items.text: The exact time when the murder had been committed was never discovered.
alternatives: The exact time when the murder had been committed was never found out.
The exact time when the murder was committed was never discovered.

items.text: I don't know why he cut the class.
alternatives: I don't know why he skipped the class.
I don't know why he skipped class.
I don't know why he cut class.
I don't know the reason why he skipped class.

items.text: I don't know where it took place.
alternatives: I don't know where that took place.
I don't know where it happened.
I don't know where it occurred.
I don't know the place where it took place.
This is where that happened.
This is the place where it happened.
This is where it occurred.
This is where it took place.

items.text: I went to the seaside where the scenery was very beautiful.
alternatives: I went to the beach where the scenery was very beautiful.
I went to the seaside where the view was very beautiful.
I went to the seaside where the scenery is very beautiful.

items.text: I went to New York, where I saw Mr. Kim.
I went to New York last year, when I saw Mr. Kim.
He showed me how he could speak English well.
alternatives: He showed me the way he could speak English well.
He showed me how he was able to speak English well.
He showed me the way in which he could speak English well.

items.text: This is why I cannot agree with you.
alternatives: This is the reason why I cannot agree with you.
This is the reason I cannot agree with you.
This is why I can't agree with your opinion.
This is why I cannot agree with your opinion.
This is the reason why I can't agree with your opinion.

items.text: It was this house that John bought last year.
alternatives: It was this house which John bought last year.

items.text: It was last year that John bought this house.
alternatives: It was last year when John bought this house.

items.text: It was John that bought this house.
alternatives: It was John who bought this house.

items.text: I started from where she lived.
alternatives: I started from where she lives.
I departed from where she lived.
I set out from where she lived.
I started from the place where she lived.

items.text: I took him where she lived.
alternatives: I took him to the place where she lived.
I took him where she lives.

items.text: He decided to give her the flower whether she liked it or not.
alternatives: He decided to give the flower to her whether she liked it or not.
He decided to give her the flower whether or not she liked it.
He decided to give her the flowers whether she liked it or not.
